artworks.title: King Amycus of the Bebryces
artworks.description: Fuseli's Bebrycian king — Poseidon's boxing tyrant who forces every lander into the caestus until Polydeuces kills him. Not the centaur Amycus of Ovid's Lapith war.

artworks.title: Amykos and the Argonauts (BnF hydria)
artworks.description: Paris BnF hydria (De Ridder 442): Amykos bound or confronted among the Argonauts — Apollonius' Bithynian bout fixed in clay.

artworks.title: Amykos and Pollux (Praenestine mirror)
artworks.description: Praeneste bronze mirror: Amykos boxed by Pollux under the moon-goddess Losna — the Bebrycian duel as Etruscan luxury art.

popCulture.title: Amycus
popCulture.description: King of the Bebryces, son of Poseidon — slain by Polydeuces when the Argonauts land in Bithynia.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius' set-piece bout: Amycus challenges strangers to box; Polydeuces answers and cracks the king's skull.

popCulture.title: Pollux
popCulture.description: The Dioscurus who kills Amycus — Castor's twin as the Argonautica's champion boxer.
